notes: Settings-owned; not a product-neutral src/ui primitive.
Synthetic labels only; no credentials, private IDs, runtime URLs, or server payloads.

labels.description: Synthetic preference description for parity only

geometry.layout: two-column settings grid on md+; stacked on narrow

expectedTokenGeometry: Control and status align to the trailing column on desktop density

r10.keyboardTouch: actionable control slot (button) is keyboard-focusable and activatable
r10.focus: control inside the row receives focus; row chrome itself is not a widget
r10.screenReader: row label text is present; status slot may host StatusPill with text
r10.reducedMotion: no motion-dependent behavior claimed for the row shell
r10.validationBusyDisabledStatus: status slot can host StatusPill; control can be a Button
r10.zoom: label remains present at component level
r10.darkLight: render under data-theme zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
r10.narrow: grid stacks to one column below md; claimed via shared viewport labels
